versions.changelog: Fix onboarding docs: replace invalid onboard flags, add required --accept-risk, add --skip-health with --skip-daemon, restore portable gateway restart guidance, and clarify configured-vs-live model verification.
Fix: add auth profile verification step before declaring migration success (prevents silent fallback to Anthropic when provider auth profile is missing)
v1.0.3: Replace journalctl/systemctl in Step 5 with openclaw models status + gateway restart.
v1.0.2: Align SKILL.md name field with ClawHub slug.
v1.0.1: Remove curl|python3 download-execute pattern. Use native openclaw CLI commands only (openclaw onboard, openclaw models set, openclaw gateway restart). Addresses security scanner concern.
Migrate OpenClaw from Claude subscription OAuth to free/cheap providers after Anthropic's April 2026 policy change. Supports OpenRouter (28+ free models), Gemini, Ollama, Kilo, Mistral, DeepSeek.
